description: doctrine — shows each dispatched seat while it runs. In a herdr session (HERDR_ENV=1) it panes the seat directly; in a contained agent (DCTR_VIEW_REQUEST_DIR set) it only writes a request file to that mount for a host-side watcher, calling no herdr. With neither set it stands down, costing one process spawn per hook event and nothing else — and that is more than one per seat: Claude Code also fires SubagentStop for its own forked queries (a prompt suggestion after most turns, memory extraction), each with an empty agent_type, so a session that dispatches no seats still spawns roughly once per turn. SessionStart after /clear (matcher clear) runs dctr-restore.mjs: when SESSION_MEMORY.md's kickoff names a handoff whose record's last state line reads Open or Blocked, it hands the new session the phase, the record path, that state line, the wrapper and the handoff as facts; otherwise it prints nothing and calls no herdr. PostToolBatch runs dctr-gauge.mjs: while that record is Open or Blocked and its last auto-cycle on/off line is on, it reads the main session's context use and, the first time it reaches the record's tier, hands the session the warning as facts and appends `- auto-cycle: warned <session id> <tier>` to the record, once per session id; a seat's batch (agent_id present) and every other case stand down, and it calls no herdr. While auto-cycle is on it also reports, on every batch, each tier or window error and each unknown context reading as facts, in additionalContext plus a systemMessage. Stop, Notification (matcher permission_prompt|idle_prompt) and StopFailure run dctr-cycle.mjs, the auto-cycle hook: each stands down unless auto-cycle is active, meaning that record is Open or Blocked, its last auto-cycle on/off line is on, and no .doctrine/auto-cycle.stop sits in the session's repo or the record's. On Stop it appends `- auto-cycle paused: <reason>` to the record for a stop file, a Blocked phase, an alarm without a ruling, an open question, a handoff not written, the cycle cap or no progress, waits while seats, gates, background tasks or crons are live, and otherwise spawns dctr-typer.mjs detached, which types /clear and a resume line into the session's herdr pane once focus moves off it. On a permission prompt, an idle prompt nothing explains, or an API error it appends a paused line too. Every paused line is alerted once, as an `autocycle` sidebar token, a herdr notification and a systemMessage in the pane. With DCTR_VIEW_REQUEST_DIR set they call no herdr. SessionStart after /clear also writes a restore file under TMPDIR/dctr-autocycle when HERDR_PANE_ID is set, which the typer waits for.
